$comment: Images of the live site (WordPress export docs/cambridgehospital.WordPress.2026-10-06.xml, attachment URLs) that would fill a placeholder or an empty image slot here. The export carries URLs only and wp-content/uploads sits behind a Cloudflare bot check (NW1): files are saved through a Chrome the user starts by hand (tools/live-images/fetch.mjs, missing-image audit 9 Oct 2026; earlier .astro/qc-bug042/fetch-live.mjs for the `conditions` group). Status per group: `conditions` wired (bug 042, tools/condition-banners/run.sh); `insurers` wired (tools/import-wp-images.mjs); `testimonials` wired under testimonials/wp/<slug> (the testimonials/live/* keys here were never used); `care` = the live Our Care hub card photos: NOT used, the hub keeps the Figma cards (services/*.png) and the KSA photos under regions/sa (bug 063); `hospitals` = the live Our Hospitals list photos: NOT used, the list keeps the Figma photos (other shots of the same buildings); `pages` = live page banners: NOT used, those pages have Figma banners. The care sub-page heroes, Outpatient cards, hospital galleries / heroes and doctor portraits restored on 9 Oct 2026 are listed in docs/missing-image-audit.md, not here.
